Checklist item: Untrusted inputs are validated server-side using allowlists and suitable type, length and constraint checks.
Notes / remediation: Replace permissive regexes with typed, allowlisted validation.

Checklist item: Database queries use parameterized queries or safe ORM APIs; no unsafe query concatenation.
Notes / remediation: Use MongoDB typed query operators; never $where with user data.

Checklist item: Output is encoded for the correct context; untrusted data is not inserted unsafely into HTML or URLs.
Evidence: server.js:137 autoescape:false; profile.js:28 HTML encoding in URL context
Notes / remediation: Enable autoescape and use URL-specific encoding for website.

Checklist item: File uploads, paths, redirects and deserialization are constrained and validated.
Notes / remediation: Allowlist redirect targets and outbound hosts.

Checklist item: Passwords use an appropriate password-hashing mechanism; no plaintext/reversible storage.
Evidence: user-dao.js:25 plaintext password stored; :61 direct equality
Notes / remediation: Store bcrypt hashes and compare with bcrypt.compareSync.

Checklist item: Authentication failures, session creation, expiry, logout and session rotation are handled safely.
Evidence: session.js:116 sets userId without regenerate; :59-98 distinct errors
Notes / remediation: Regenerate session on login and use uniform auth failure messages.

Checklist item: Authorization is checked server-side for each protected resource and action.
Evidence: index.js:55-60 isAdmin defined but not applied to benefits
Notes / remediation: Attach isAdmin middleware to both benefits routes.

Checklist item: Sensitive actions have appropriate re-authentication, MFA and CSRF protections where applicable.
Evidence: server.js:7,107 csrf disabled; no MFA path found
Notes / remediation: Enable CSRF tokens; add re-auth/MFA for administrative changes.

Checklist item: Errors do not expose stack traces, secrets, internal paths, SQL details or sensitive data.
Notes / remediation: Log server-side with IDs; render generic client error pages.

Checklist item: Exceptions are handled safely; failures do not bypass validation or authorization.
Notes / remediation: Reviewed callbacks propagate errors without bypassing checks.

Checklist item: Security events are logged without passwords, tokens or sensitive payloads.
Evidence: session.js:64 logs invalid username; error.js:7-8 stack only
Notes / remediation: Introduce structured audit events with redaction.

Checklist item: Files, sockets, database connections and locks are reliably released.
Evidence: No lifecycle test performed in this review
Notes / remediation: Verify connection and socket cleanup in a follow-up review.

Checklist item: Request sizes, upload sizes, execution time and expensive operations are bounded.
Evidence: profile.js:59 nested quantifier; research.js:16 no timeout
Notes / remediation: Add limits and timeouts; replace the regex.

Checklist item: Concurrency, memory allocation and cleanup paths are handled safely.
Evidence: Not verified within the limited scope
Notes / remediation: Schedule focused concurrency and memory review.

Checklist item: Debug mode, verbose errors, default accounts and sample credentials are disabled/removed in production.
Evidence: server.js:137 autoescape false; artifacts/db-reset.js seed users
Notes / remediation: Remove training defaults before production deployment.

Checklist item: Secrets are outside source code and protected through configuration/secret management.
Notes / remediation: Use environment variables or a secret manager and rotate values.

Checklist item: Security headers, TLS, cookie flags and CORS policies are appropriately configured.
Evidence: server.js:10 helmet commented; :22-152 TLS block commented; ZAP missing CSP/X-Content-Type-Options
Notes / remediation: Enable helmet, TLS, HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite cookies and review CORS.

Checklist item: Dependencies are maintained; unnecessary services, permissions and endpoints are disabled.
Evidence: Docker build: 902 npm vulnerabilities; Dockerfile:1 node:12-alpine
Notes / remediation: Upgrade dependencies and base image; run npm audit in CI.
